summary: This directory contains the testing suite for the parsing logic of the analysis module. Its primary purpose is to verify the correct identification and extraction of protected regions and generated markers from source code content.
responsibilities: Verify the parsing of generated markers
Validate the computation and extraction of protected sections
Ensure correct identification of protected regions within files
relationships: The test suite validates the parsing logic responsible for identifying generated markers and protected sections.
Protected sections are computed based on the successful parsing of markers identified in the source code.
designDecisions: Co-location of tests with the parsing logic they validate
Focus on unit-level validation of regex or structural parsing patterns
